scope: Client-only deterministic reproduction. No backend JWT/RLS claim. Synthetic A/B records only.
network: Ordinary fetch rejects all calls. Actual SDK uses an in-memory HTTP 503 response and never opens a socket.
confirmed: STATIC-03: delayed A read overwrites B cache and is readable offline as B
STATIC-05: failed A media backup logs URL surviving sign-out and reloaded by B Sync Center
protected: Locked @supabase/auth-js 2.110.3 clears token and emits SIGNED_OUT after returned HTTP 503; real AuthContext follows this event and clears React user/session.
robustness_only: Injected exceptional signOut throw leaves React user/session while fallback token/cache are removed. This is not the ordinary SDK HTTP/network error path and is not promoted to a confirmed security finding.
